source: CUAD v1 and the CUAD Commercial Contracts Labeling Handbook (September 9, 2021)
scope: Presence identification only. Descriptions and cues retrieve candidate clauses; they do not make risk, deviation, or gap decisions.

provisions.description: A ceiling, time limit, or maximum recovery applying to liability for breach.
exclusions: Do not label a list of uncapped-liability exceptions unless the same span also states a cap or other liability ceiling.

provisions.description: Automatic or unilateral extension of the agreement after the initial term.
exclusions: Do not label the initial term or a renewal that requires a new mutual agreement; the extension must be automatic or exercisable by one party.

provisions.description: Advance notice required to prevent or terminate a renewal.
exclusions: Do not label a general termination notice period unless the text ties the notice to renewal or expiration.
candidatePhrases: prior to the expiration of the then
before the end of the then

provisions.description: The state, province, or country whose law governs interpretation of the agreement.
exclusions: Do not label venue, forum, or arbitration location alone when no governing law is identified.

provisions.description: Exclusive dealing, requirements purchasing, or restrictions on working with third parties.
exclusions: Do not label an exclusive remedy, an exclusive jurisdiction clause, or an intellectual-property license merely because it uses the word exclusive.

provisions.description: A right to terminate without cause after notice or a waiting period.
exclusions: Do not label termination limited to breach, insolvency, force majeure, or another stated cause.

provisions.description: A party has the right to terminate, or consent or notice of the counterparty is required, if a party undergoes a change of control, such as a merger, stock sale, transfer of all or substantially all of its assets or business, or assignment by operation of law.
exclusions: Do not label an anti-assignment clause that only restricts assigning the agreement to a third party; the text must tie consent, notice, or termination to a change in the ownership or control of a party.

provisions.description: A right to inspect or audit books, records, systems, or locations for compliance.
exclusions: Do not label a reference to a party's normal financial audit unless another party receives an inspection, access, or assurance-report right.

provisions.description: A requirement that a party maintain specified insurance coverage.
exclusions: Do not label a passing reference to insurers or insurance proceeds without an obligation to maintain coverage or provide evidence of it.

provisions.description: The period during which a warranty against defects or errors applies.
exclusions: Do not label a warranty or disclaimer that does not state a duration, deadline, or measurable warranty period.
